title: Warm Russian Couscous Pilaf
description: A briny and springy lacto-vegetarian dish from Russia featuring couscous, served in an agave leaf vessel, perfect for a cold day. This pilaf is energizing and full of flavor.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Add the couscous to the saucepan, cover, and turn off the heat.
Let the couscous sit for 5 minutes, then fluff it with a fork.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the grated carrot to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
Spoon the cooked couscous mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Top the couscous with crumbled feta cheese and chopped fresh dill.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
